root_cause: The guard sampled only the external checkout and chosen profile volumes. Its lease, unsafe hold, and stop markers use /var/tmp on the internal writable system volume. The internal volume reached approximately 116 MiB free while both sampled external paths remained ample, so admission and watchdog missed ENOSPC.
observed_red_evidence: docs/stabilization/resource-journals/d54-data-tsv-native-20261002-01.jsonl records RESOURCE_WATCH_HEALTHY at 2026-10-02T19:58:43 with repo/profile at about 1695 GiB free, followed by RESOURCE_MEASUREMENT_FAILED and RESOURCE_FINAL_DECISION invalid, exit 2. docs/stabilization/runs/d54-data-tsv-native-20261002-01.json records the unsafe-hold marker persistence failure on /var/tmp with ENOSPC. The browser assertions passed, but this guard result invalidated the native run.

observed_read_only_mounts.system_root_and_data: df -k showed / and /System/Volumes/Data each with 117384 KiB free at diagnosis time; both are in the same APFS container on this host.

observed_hosted_run: Hosted macOS run 37062362091 had about 95 GiB system disk free but refused the prior live fixture on CPU_BUSY and CPU_HIGH_LOAD_BUSY at preflight (memory about 5.74 GiB). The marker failure was not reached; this is a failed/insufficient runtime result, not GREEN. Round two injects deterministic healthy non-disk telemetry only in scratch guard copies while retaining the real policy, preflight, reasons, watchdog, workload, and persistence paths. Actual hosted disk admission still skips below the unchanged 20 GiB floor and states the measurement.

source_change.disk_admission_and_watchdog: Every sample reads the repo, profile, actual lease root, and / independently. All four are compared with the existing minimumFreeDiskGiB=20 in the shared reasons() path used by preflight and watchdog. A future lease relocation cannot remove the system-volume check.
source_change.persistence_failure: Writes to unsafe hold and stop markers use a private 0600 writer. Any write failure marks the run invalid and the safety state broken before throwing, keeps the heavy lease, stops owned work during cleanup, and records an invalid final decision when the journal remains writable. The original error payload and marker contents are not reflected in diagnostics.

policy: No threshold, concurrency, or command allowlist changes. The local guard must continue refusing below 20 GiB on the system volume. The focused helper test is wired to the existing hosted CI checks job on a healthy runner.
planned_forcing_checks: Injected statfs measurements with external repo/profile/lease at 1600 GiB and independent / at 116 MiB must trigger disk-low under the unchanged 20 GiB floor.
A low lease volume independently triggers disk-low; the default statfs implementation reads actual mounted paths and rejects invalid values.
A real private 0600 marker is written, and injected ENOSPC surfaces RESOURCE_SAFETY_STATE_WRITE_FAILED without payload reflection.
Copied-guard process and journal fixture suites include the new disk helper so their existing integration assertions still run against the actual guard.

A macOS CI subprocess fixture starts the copied real guard and a live owned workload, makes its hold marker read-only after admission, and requires exit 3, an invalid final journal decision, a retained owner lease, and stopped owned work. The fixture keeps the 20 GiB floor unchanged and shortens only its isolated sampling intervals.

A second macOS CI subprocess fixture replaces resource measurements in a scratch guard copy: deterministic healthy CPU/memory/pressure/swap keep unrelated hosted load from masking the disk boundary, while low / with healthy repo, profile and lease must refuse preflight; a lease volume that falls after admission must trigger RESOURCE_DISK_LOW, stop the live owned workload, and finish invalid. Both cases drive the real guard reasons(), not the helper in isolation. They should fail if reasons() drops diskIsLow().
